construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation written in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: Exact fields: schema_version, synthetic:true, documents[], issues[]. Documents: id,title,text,claims[]. Claims: canonical lowercase topic, stance(supports/opposes/uncertain), quote verbatim in document text. Issues: id,text,severity(low/medium/high/critical),document_ids[]. IDs and issue references are unique and references must exist. Empty collections are accepted.
shared_schema.output: status, schema_version, synthetic, sentiment{schema_version,issues[]}, research{schema_version,findings[]}. Errors: status:error,error:string with exit 2.
shared_schema.validation: One validate entry point dispatches input and both intermediate/output schemas. Stage validators replay deterministic transformations against validated source context, checking ordering, provenance, scores and complete evidence. Strict JSON rejects duplicate keys and nonstandard constants.

cross_stage_handoffs: Research receives the validated sentiment envelope, not raw issues. It preserves issue IDs, ranked order, severity, priority, document references, sentiment score and label.
Research dereferences only documents attached to each prioritized issue. Every extracted evidence quote retains document ID and title.

behavior.sentiment: Casefolded whole-word fixed lexicon; contributions expose token, word index, base weight, negation and contribution. not/never/no negate the next sentiment word within three subsequent word tokens, bounded by punctuation. Sum sign determines label. No sarcasm, morphology or contraction inference.
behavior.priority: Severity base low=0, medium=100, high=200, critical=300 plus min(99,max(0,-sentiment_score)*10). Severity always dominates sentiment. Ties sort by issue ID.
behavior.research: Aggregate explicitly annotated grounded claims per canonical topic. Counts are distinct document IDs per stance, not claim counts. Both supporting and opposing evidence means disputed; otherwise uncertain evidence means inconclusive; otherwise supported/opposed. Evidence is never majority-voted away.
behavior.unresolved_questions: Flag conflicts, uncertainty, single-document support, no claims and attached documents missing annotations. Different document IDs are source counts, not a guarantee of independent authorship.
behavior.determinism: No randomness, time fields, network access, model provider or filesystem writes at runtime. Input objects are not mutated. CLI also accepts '-' for JSON stdin.
behavior.synthetic_fixture: All example documents, claims and customer issues are synthetic.

test_outcomes.cli_output: One valid JSON object with status ok, three prioritized issues and three propagated research findings
